title: Add continuous background music playback with mute control

requirements.text: Add continuous background music that plays throughout the entire Valentine experience (both the question and celebration stages) using the requested track reference: “glue song” by beabadoobee (sped up + pitched) from https://youtube.com/shorts/Zy02CEOqrR4?si=ULEbg8LDnjIwxoc3.

quotes:
Can you add a song which will be playing in the background the whole time
Song is glue song by babadoobee (sped up + pitched) .. https://youtube.com/shorts/Zy02CEOqrR4?si=ULEbg8LDnjIwxoc3 this is the song link

acceptanceCriteria: Background music starts and continues playing across stage transitions (question <-> celebration) without restarting due to component remounts.
Music loops continuously when it reaches the end.
The implementation references the provided link in code comments or documentation as the user-provided source reference, without breaking the app if the link is unreachable.

requirements.text: Serve the background music as a static frontend asset (do not stream from YouTube): add an audio file under the frontend public folder (e.g., frontend/public/assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3) and play it via a stable /assets/... URL from the React UI.

quotes: Song is glue song by babadoobee (sped up + pitched) .. https://youtube.com/shorts/Zy02CEOqrR4?si=ULEbg8LDnjIwxoc3 this is the song link

acceptanceCriteria: The app does not attempt to embed or stream audio from the YouTube Shorts URL.
The audio file is loaded from a local static path under frontend/public and is requested successfully in the browser network tab (200).
No backend changes are required to deliver the audio bytes.

requirements.text: Add an accessible music control UI that allows the user to toggle background music on/off (mute/unmute) while preserving the current visual theme and layout (mobile + desktop).

quotes: Can you add a song which will be playing in the background the whole time

acceptanceCriteria: A clearly discoverable control is present on the page (e.g., in the header area) with English label text such as “Music: On/Off” (or equivalent).
The control is keyboard accessible and has appropriate aria-labels.
Turning music off immediately silences playback; turning it on resumes playback.
The music setting persists for the user across page reloads (e.g., via localStorage).

requirements.text: Ensure background audio playback behavior is compatible with modern browser autoplay policies by requiring a user interaction to start playback when needed (without showing intrusive prompts).

quotes: playing in the background the whole time

acceptanceCriteria: On first page load, if autoplay is blocked, the app does not throw errors and provides a clear path to start music via the music toggle control.
After the user’s first interaction (e.g., tapping the music toggle or another primary action), playback can start successfully.
No console errors are emitted during audio initialization/cleanup when switching stages or pressing Start over.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not stream, embed, or fetch audio directly from the provided YouTube Shorts URL; serve audio from static assets under frontend/public.
Keep the backend as-is (single Motoko actor); do not add backend endpoints for media serving.
nonGoals: Handling music licensing/rights or downloading/transcoding audio from YouTube automatically.
Adding a playlist, track search, or multiple songs.
Adding real-time synchronization or beat-matched animations tied to audio.
